_readme: Attio call lists that feed CloudTalk campaigns. Membership of a list = the CloudTalk contact carries the tag. Positive Replies has its own job (positive_replies_to_call_queue.py). 'campaigns' = the CloudTalk campaigns that serve the tag (legacy = my.cloudtalk.io/api, dialer = api.cloudtalk.io/v1). The job needs at least ONE of them active; it never switches an inactive one on (Ife 2026-10-12). A list with no campaign (and no dialer campaign named exactly like its tag) gets a new dialer campaign created from the template.
